"use client"

import { Avatar, AvatarFallback, AvatarImage, Item, ItemContent, ItemDescription, ItemMedia, ItemTitle, SidebarMenu, SidebarMenuItem } from "@clossys/designer-ui"

/** The local user row's data. */
export interface ShellUser { name: string; email: string; avatar?: string; initials: string }

/** sidebar-07's sample avatar image; Producer serves every `/avatars/*` image as the workspace placeholder. */
const SAMPLE_AVATAR = "/avatars/shadcn.jpg"

/** sidebar-07 profile row on a static stock Item; the existing local workspace has no account menu. */
export function NavUser({ user }: { user: ShellUser }) {
  return (
    <SidebarMenu>
      <SidebarMenuItem>
        <Item size="sm" data-sidebar-static-row="user">
          <ItemMedia>
            <Avatar>
              <AvatarImage src={user.avatar ?? SAMPLE_AVATAR} alt={user.name} />
              <AvatarFallback>{user.initials}</AvatarFallback>
            </Avatar>
          </ItemMedia>
          <ItemContent>
            <ItemTitle>{user.name}</ItemTitle>
            <ItemDescription>{user.email}</ItemDescription>
          </ItemContent>
        </Item>
      </SidebarMenuItem>
    </SidebarMenu>
  )
}

"use client"

import { Item, ItemContent, ItemDescription, ItemMedia, ItemTitle, SidebarMenu, SidebarMenuItem } from "@clossys/designer-ui"

/** The one workspace row's data: its name, plan line and mark. */
export interface ShellTeam { name: string; plan: string; logo?: React.ReactNode }

/**
 * sidebar-07 workspace row; Studio supplies one workspace, so no switch menu is rendered. The
 * block's logo tile and two-line label are the stock Item image media, title and description, on a static stock Item (no button, ref or press handler).
 */
export function TeamSwitcher({ team }: { team?: ShellTeam }) {
  if (!team) return null
  return (
    <SidebarMenu>
      <SidebarMenuItem>
        <Item size="sm" data-sidebar-static-row="team">
          <ItemMedia variant="image">{team.logo}</ItemMedia>
          <ItemContent>
            <ItemTitle>{team.name}</ItemTitle>
            <ItemDescription>{team.plan}</ItemDescription>
          </ItemContent>
        </Item>
      </SidebarMenuItem>
    </SidebarMenu>
  )
}

{
  "$schema": "https://ui.shadcn.com/schema/registry-item.json",
  "name": "studio-shell",
  "type": "registry:block",
  "title": "Studio Shell",
  "description": "The shadcn sidebar-15 block (left and right sidebars) as the Studio app shell: the left sidebar is the sidebar-07 nav (team switcher as the consumer brand, the Studio map as navMain, the local workspace as the user), the right sidebar is the chat; header toggles at both ends, every other header icon a popover from the page manifest, and the command menu.",
  "author": "Clossys",
  "dependencies": [],
  "registryDependencies": [
    "avatar",
    "breadcrumb",
    "button",
    "card",
    "collapsible",
    "command",
    "empty",
    "field",
    "item",
    "popover",
    "scroll-area",
    "separator",
    "sidebar",
    "skeleton",
    "tooltip"
  ]
}
